shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat src/transport/ws/validation.ts; cat src/infrastructure/stores/inMemorySessionStore.ts; cat src/transport/createServer.ts | head -110; cat jest.config.js | head -90'
/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --stat; rg -n \"it\\('\" src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts; test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs && echo present; git status -sb"

/bin/zsh -lc "git show HEAD:specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md > /tmp/hal-spec-original
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md')

npx prettier --write src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md
rg -n \"it\\('\" src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.+#' src/transport/*.test.ts | head; sed -i '' -e 's/#L37/#L38/' -e 's/#L54/#L55/' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md 2>/dev/null || sed -i -e 's/#L37/#L38/' -e 's/#L54/#L55/' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts');s=p.read_text().replace(\"  const socket = new WebSocket("'`ws://127.0.0.1:${port}/hal/ws`, [HAL_WS_SUBPROTOCOL, '"'token']);\", \"  const serverClosed = new Promise<void>(resolve => {\\n    server.wss.once('connection', ws => ws.once('close', () => resolve()));\\n  });\\n  const socket = new WebSocket("'`ws://127.0.0.1:${port}/hal/ws`, [HAL_WS_SUBPROTOCOL, '"'token']);\");s=s.replace('    await closed;\\n    await server.stop();','    await closed;\\n    await serverClosed;\\n    await server.stop();');p.write_text(s)
